items.prompt: After erasing a vector element while looping, which step follows the shown safe pattern?

options.text: Assign the returned next iterator to it
options.why: The old erased position is invalidated.

options.text: Increment the erased old iterator first
Dereference the old end to find the final record
Assume erased bytes define a lasting record ID
options.why: Storage bytes are not an identity/lifetime contract.

items.explanation: erase returns the next valid iterator or updated end, so the loop can continue without using the invalid old iterator.
